title: SEE_AP_AR_DATA bundle = presence of both new AP/AR atoms
preconds: Build with CRP-BE-SEC deployed. Two custom roles created via the API: 'AP/AR On' (SEE_AP_AR_DATA bundle ON) and 'AP/AR Off' (toggle OFF).
steps:
1. Hit GET /api/auth/me/fe-permissions while authenticated as a user on 'AP/AR On'.
2. Inspect the returned atom set.
3. Resolve the atoms for that user via a BE diagnostic.
4. Confirm ROLE_ACCOUNT_RECEIVABLE_REPORT::VIEW and ROLE_ACCOUNT_PAYABLE_REPORT::VIEW are in the resolved set.
5. Repeat for the 'AP/AR Off' user; confirm both atoms are absent.
expected: AP/AR-On user has both new atoms resolved. AP/AR-Off user has neither. Both atoms travel only via SEE_AP_AR_DATA.
